steps.title: เข้าสู่ระบบแบบ Demo
วันที่วันนี้ (ค.ศ./พ.ศ.) และวันที่ +15/+7 วัน สำหรับเทียบช่องวันที่บนหน้าจอ
steps.sql:
with d as (select (now() at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok')::date as t)
   select to_char(t, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as today, to_char(t, 'DD/MM/') || (extract(year from t)::int + 543)::text as today_be,
     to_char(t + 15, 'DD/MM/') || (extract(year from t + 15)::int + 543)::text as exp_be, to_char(t + 7, 'DD/MM/') || (extract(year from t + 7)::int + 543)::text as send_be from d

steps.title: เลือกเจ้าหนี้จริงที่ไม่มีเอกสารเจ้าหนี้ค้าง ไม่มีส่วนลดตั้งต้น และชื่อบางส่วนค้นแล้วเจอรายเดียว
steps.sql:
with cand as (select s.code, s.name_1, substr(s.name_1, 2) as frag from ap_supplier s left join ap_supplier_detail sd on sd.ap_code = s.code
   where coalesce(s.status, 0) = 0 and length(coalesce(s.name_1, '')) >= 6 and s.code ~ '^[A-Z0-9-]+$' and coalesce(trim(sd.discount_item), '') in ('', '0')
     and not exists (select 1 from ic_trans t where t.cust_code = s.code and coalesce(t.last_status, 0) = 0 and t.trans_flag in (10, 11, 12, 14, 16, 20, 25, 81, 83, 85, 87, 89, 91, 260, 262, 264, 310, 315, 316, 317))
     and not exists (select 1 from ap_ar_trans a where a.cust_code = s.code and coalesce(a.last_status, 0) = 0))
   select code as supp, name_1 as sname, frag as sfrag from cand
   where (select count(*) from ap_supplier x where x.name_1 ilike '%' || replace(replace(cand.frag, '%', '\%'), '_', '\_') || '%') = 1
   order by code desc offset 0 limit 1

steps.title: เลือกสินค้าจริงลำดับที่ 6 (เรียงตามรหัส) จากบิลซื้อจริง: หน่วยซื้อเริ่มต้น = หน่วยมาตรฐาน 1:1 ไม่มีส่วนลดตั้งต้น ไม่ระงับซื้อ พร้อมราคาซื้อและอัตราภาษีล่าสุด
steps.sql:
select x.item, x.iname, x.unit, x.price, x.rate from (select distinct on (d.item_code) d.item_code as item, i.name_1 as iname, d.unit_code as unit, d.price::text as price, t.vat_rate::text as rate
 from ic_trans t join ic_trans_detail d on d.doc_no = t.doc_no and d.trans_flag = t.trans_flag join ic_inventory i on i.code = d.item_code
 join ic_unit_use u on u.ic_code = d.item_code and u.code = d.unit_code and u.stand_value = 1 and u.divide_value = 1
 left join lateral (select start_purchase_unit, discount, is_hold_purchase from ic_inventory_detail where ic_code = i.code limit 1) dt on true
 where t.trans_flag = 12 and t.inquiry_type = 0 and t.vat_type = 0 and t.doc_no not like 'UAT%' and coalesce(t.is_cancel, 0) = 0 and t.last_status = 0 and d.price > 0 and coalesce(d.discount, '') = ''
   and d.stand_value = 1 and d.divide_value = 1 and coalesce(d.tax_type, 0) = 0 and coalesce(i.tax_type, 0) = 0 and coalesce(i.item_type, 0) = 0 and coalesce(i.ic_serial_no, 0) = 0
   and i.unit_standard = d.unit_code and coalesce(nullif(trim(dt.start_purchase_unit), ''), i.unit_standard) = i.unit_standard and coalesce(trim(dt.discount), '') in ('', '0')
   and coalesce(dt.is_hold_purchase, 0) = 0 and coalesce(i.name_1, '') <> '' and i.code ~ '^[A-Z0-9-]+$'
 order by d.item_code, t.doc_date desc, t.roworder desc) x order by x.item offset 5 limit 1

steps.title: คำนวณยอดที่คาดหวังของจำนวน 12 / 10 / 8 (ราคาจริง × จำนวน ภาษีแยกนอกตามอัตราจริง)
steps.sql: select round(12 * :'price'::numeric, 2)::text as q12_sum, round(round(12 * :'price'::numeric, 2) * :'rate'::numeric / 100, 2)::text as q12_vat, (round(12 * :'price'::numeric, 2) + round(round(12 * :'price'::numeric, 2) * :'rate'::numeric / 100, 2))::text as q12_total, round(10 * :'price'::numeric, 2)::text as q10_sum, round(round(10 * :'price'::numeric, 2) * :'rate'::numeric / 100, 2)::text as q10_vat, (round(10 * :'price'::numeric, 2) + round(round(10 * :'price'::numeric, 2) * :'rate'::numeric / 100, 2))::text as q10_total, round(8 * :'price'::numeric, 2)::text as q8_sum, round(round(8 * :'price'::numeric, 2) * :'rate'::numeric / 100, 2)::text as q8_vat, (round(8 * :'price'::numeric, 2) + round(round(8 * :'price'::numeric, 2) * :'rate'::numeric / 100, 2))::text as q8_total, to_char(round(10 * :'price'::numeric, 2), 'FM999,999,999,990.00') as q10_sum_fmt, to_char((round(10 * :'price'::numeric, 2) + round(round(10 * :'price'::numeric, 2) * :'rate'::numeric / 100, 2)), 'FM999,999,999,990.00') as q10_total_fmt

steps.sql:
select d.item_code, d.qty::text, d.price::text, d.ref_doc_no, d.ref_row::text, d.temp_float_1::text, h.remark, coalesce(h.not_approve_1, 0)::text as not_appr
         from ic_trans h join ic_trans_detail d on d.doc_no = h.doc_no and d.trans_flag = h.trans_flag where h.doc_no = :'pra' and h.trans_flag = 4

cleanup.sql: select (select count(*) from ic_trans where doc_no in (:'pr', :'pra')) + (select count(*) from ic_trans_detail where doc_no in (:'pr', :'pra')) + (select count(*) from ap_ar_trans where doc_no in (:'pr', :'pra')) + (select count(*) from ap_ar_trans_detail where doc_no in (:'pr', :'pra')) + (select count(*) from cb_trans where doc_no in (:'pr', :'pra')) + (select count(*) from cb_trans_detail where doc_no in (:'pr', :'pra')) + (select count(*) from gl_journal where doc_no in (:'pr', :'pra')) + (select count(*) from gl_journal_detail where doc_no in (:'pr', :'pra')) + (select count(*) from gl_journal_vat_buy where doc_no in (:'pr', :'pra')) + (select count(*) from gl_journal_vat_sale where doc_no in (:'pr', :'pra')) + (select count(*) from gl_wht_list where doc_no in (:'pr', :'pra')) + (select count(*) from gl_wht_list_detail where doc_no in (:'pr', :'pra')) + (select count(*) from ic_trans where trans_flag = 4 and doc_ref = :'pr') as left_rows
